name: @vox-pop/design-tokens
description: Vox Pop design tokens — CSS variables, TS constants, and the shared Tailwind preset consumed by apps/web (Next.js) and apps/embed (Vite, future).
//exports: `default`, not `import`. tsconfig emits COMMONJS here, but every subpath
used to be exposed under the `import` condition alone — so `require()` of a
perfectly requireable CJS file was rejected by the exports map itself with
That is not hypothetical: tailwind.config.ts does
loader postcss uses for it (jiti) resolves in CJS mode. It broke the
Cloudflare build of apps/public with exactly that error. It stayed hidden
locally because the Astro/Vite path resolves the same config through ESM.
`default` matches any condition, so both module systems reach the file.
`types` must stay FIRST — conditions are matched in declaration order.
